scheduler_age_diagnostic.scope: The schedule-entry age is sampled immediately after output processing and describes CPU loop delay. Actual resident progress stalls are recomputed between successive nonempty CPU commit callbacks, including the interval crossing injection. These intervals include GPU waiting and CPU processing and retain their diagnostic scope. Nonblocking GPU feedback is recorded separately.

async_selection.limits: Empirical p95 from36 short requests/process. Process-level confirmation only for a promising candidate. No p99 or statistical no-regression guarantee.

sampling_scope: Fresh service process is the independent unit. Three mixed trials yield36 short requests/process. Empirical p95 uses ceil(.95*(n-1)) in sorted observations. Formal mixed/cache timing and diagnostic pool/age passes retain separate identities.
